description: This header file defines the exported API functions for the Server Detection Object (SDO) in the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It declares object creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions for the SDO component, facilitating interaction with the object via defined interfaces.

methods.name: CfSdoComponentCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the SDO component with provided context handles.

methods.name: CfSdoCreate
methods.description: Creates an instance of the SDO object with specified context handles.

methods.name: CfSdoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the SDO object instance.

methods.name: CfSdoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers internal objects needed by the SDO.

methods.name: CfSdoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the SDO object, setting up necessary state.
